Hello and welcome back.

Funding rounds dominated the weekend, with Germany and Ukraine working together on drones, big raises in biotech and AI, plus two acquisitions.

Let's dive in.

💰 Funding rounds

  • Breye Therapeutics raised €67.5m Series A to advance oral therapies for early treatment of retinal diseases toward clinical studies. Read more here.

  • Trustly received $40m in equity investment commitments to accelerate its AI-powered growth strategy. Read more here.

  • Kuro raised €10m to build artificial intelligence foundation for general contractors. Read more here.

  • Omnio raised €2.9m to advance its plasminogen-based therapy for hard-to-heal chronic wounds toward clinical studies. Read more here.

💡 Other news

  • ARX Robotics and Roboneers established strategic partnership to scale unmanned ground vehicle production and system integration for Ukrainian forces. Read more here.

  • Quantum Systems secured German government funding to scale production of tens of thousands of interceptor drones in Ukraine through joint venture with WIY Drones. Read more here.

🤝 M&A

  • CareMaster got acquired by Lottie to expand into artificial intelligence for care billing, payments and credit control. Read more here.
